answer: I would stop farms with document signing certificate proof, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here: 729 aliases need 729 independent proofs, and one failed proof burns the whole cluster's bond. The jetty test is the live device, the relic test is the locked stake, and the harbor test is the graded history no template can fake. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
